request-path-health.description: Shows how latency moves through the request path alongside independent diagnostic context. Component times are not additive, and the asynchronous pipeline and indexing measures are never added to request latency.

failure-localization.description: Compares illustrative failure-rate signals across eight workloads so follow-up can be located. Each rate has its own denominator, so the values are compared and never summed, and no approved threshold or breach is implied.

capacity-and-efficiency.description: Shows measured cost and token consumption per request beside capacity signals that have no approved definition or formula yet. Pending states do not stand in for a zero or for a favorable value.

ai-and-model-quality.description: Shows the three compatible 1-5 evaluator scores as a trend. Retrieval quality and the 0-1 MLflow correctness score are reported separately because they are measured on their own scales.

evaluator-readiness.description: Shows which safety and security evidence is available for follow-up. The illustrative MLflow score does not imply a favorable result, and no incident, breach, or successful attack is claimed.
